t: For the purposes of this Act the Supreme Court grounds shall be held to extend to the line of the face of the east curb of First Street Northeast, between Maryland Avenue Northeast and East Capitol Street; to the line of the face of the south curb of Maryland Avenue Northeast, between First Street Northeast and Second Street Northeast; to the line of the face of the west curb of Second Street Northeast, between Maryland Avenue Northeast and East Capitol Street; and to the line of the face of the north curb of East Capitol Street between First Street Northeast and Second Street Northeast.

fable.w: This section only defines the geographic boundaries of the Supreme Court grounds by reference to street curbs. There is no tempting participation reading: it involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
fable.s: For the purposes of this Act the Supreme Court grounds shall be held to extend to the line of the face of the east curb of First Street Northeast

opus.w: The section only defines the geographic extent of the Supreme Court grounds by reference to street curb lines. No outside party is consulted or involved in any federal decision, and there is no rulemaking, hearing or right to sue. Nothing about it could reasonably be read as participation.

opus.b:

It has no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue, and no one outside the federal government plays any part in a decision.
